rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something located in or related to the northeast.

example.traditional: 東北面嘅入口喺邊度呀？
example.jyutping: dung1 bak1 min6 ge3 jap6 hau2 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3

rows.note: Use this when referring to the northeastern part of a larger territory or area.

example.english: The roads in the northeastern part of this city are always congested.
example.traditional: 呢個城市東北部嘅公路成日塞車。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 dung1 bak1 bou6 ge3 gung1 lou6 sing4 jat6 sak1 ce1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a person or thing that comes from the northeast.

example.english: They are from the northeastern region.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 dung1 bak1 lai4 ge3
